classification.difficultyReason: Count unit boundary lengths, including the two inward notches in part c.

content.prompt: The figures shown below are drawn on a 1 cm grid. Find the perimeter of each figure, in centimetres.

spec.description: Three-by-three dashed unit grid with a solid boundary around the entire middle column. A blank-grid template cannot express the supplied polygon boundary.
spec.mathematics: A rectangle 1 cm wide and 3 cm high.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the grid and supplied outline are visible; no dimensions or answers are added.

spec.description: Three-by-three dashed unit grid with a solid boundary around the bottom two complete rows. A blank-grid template cannot express the supplied polygon boundary.
spec.mathematics: A rectangle 3 cm wide and 2 cm high.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the grid and supplied outline are visible; no dimensions or answers are added.

spec.description: H-shaped polygon on a three-by-three dashed unit grid, with one-cell notches at the top centre and bottom centre. A blank-grid template cannot express the supplied notched boundary.
spec.mathematics: Both outer columns and the central cell are enclosed. Two outer vertical sides have length 3 cm; the other ten boundary segments each have length 1 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: The complete supplied boundary and dashed grid remain visible; boundary counts and the answer appear only in solutions.

answer.short:
$16\text{ cm}$

Count every boundary edge, including both notches.
answer.worked:
The two outer vertical sides are each 3 cm long. The remaining boundary consists of ten 1 cm segments, including the edges inside both notches.
$$\begin{align*}P&=3+3+10\times1\\P&=16\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
